A deploy free, fire free blaster for Biker Scouts is one of the most sought-after cards in booster draft play. It has average hitting power, destiny > defense value, but it can take out any pesky Ewok (like [[Wicket]] or Chirpa) or Rebel (like Kensaric or Beezer) who is giving you trouble. A Dark side spy can also fire for free, making this a very good weapon to use with [[Sniper]]. The destiny 4 number on this blaster is decent, too. Deploying [[Biker Scout Gear]] will make the [[Scout Blaster]] a 6 when drawn as destiny.

Combos: [[Scout Blaster]] is really well integrated into the [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] expansion, with game text on many cards providing additional benefits:

is a mean combination, a destiny draw that can make your Light side target either temporarily disarmed, or power and forfeit 0

- adds 1 to his total weapon destiny.

- [[Arcona]] beware!

- for a free shot at your opponent during the control phase.

By: Joe Alread

While the [[Scout Blaster]] is just like an everyday blaster to most characters, in an [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] deck it becomes quite the accessory. The ability to hold onto this weapon until after your opponent has initiated a battle brings the important advantage of surprise to your side of the table.

Combos: - The ability to deploy weapons for free only when you absolutely need them is always a plus.
